# NEW 2026-11-19 Yuan track Y5b (the Yuan princes, oe_yw_). Generated by gen_yuan_y5b.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Any scope. Months since 1337.4 for the current date (1337.4 = 0; the same index as Y4's oe_yv_m_now and Y1's oe_y1_m_now).
oe_yw_m_now = {
    value = current_year
    subtract = 1337
    multiply = 12
    subtract = 4
    if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 2 } add = 2 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 3 } add = 3 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 4 } add = 4 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 5 } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 6 } add = 6 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 7 } add = 7 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 8 } add = 8 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 9 } add = 9 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 10 } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 11 } add = 11 }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 12 } add = 12 }
}
# Any scope. The current year, and the year before (grant and attendance records).
oe_yw_year = { value = current_year }
oe_yw_year_prev = { value = current_year subtract = 1 }
# CHI scope. Event costs: months of trade and tax income (Y4's oe_yv_cost_*), with a floor.
oe_yw_cost_1m = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax min = 10 }
oe_yw_cost_3m = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = 3 min = 30 }
oe_yw_cost_6m = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = 6 min = 60 }
# CHI scope. The grant unit: 0.04 of a month's trade and tax income, 1-20 gold (a full roll of weight 12 is about
# half a month's income a year).
oe_yw_grant_unit_value = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = 0.04 min = 1 max = 20 }
# Any scope. Sum of the grant weights of the members (Yuan shi 95 ranks; Shen 0).
oe_yw_wsum = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:QAS c:QAS = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } add = 2 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HCN c:HCN = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } add = 2 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:OTC c:OTC = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } add = 2 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BGT c:BGT = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } add = 2 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:OGE c:OGE = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LNG c:LNG = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YLU c:YLU = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YZW c:YZW = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YBN c:YBN = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } add = 1 }
}
# Prince scope (phase 3, M2). The part of its grant share a prince receives while its appanage is lost, by the choice of
# event .8 (oe_yw_fy 1 made good 1, 2 halved 0.5, 3 stopped 0); 1 otherwise. The Yuan pays 1.5 / 0.5 / 0 of the
# share (oe_yw_wpay): the extra half of choice 1 is the silk bought in its place.
oe_yw_fy_k_recv = {
    value = 1
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_fy ?= 1 } value = 1 }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_fy ?= 2 } value = 0.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 } value = 0 }
    }
}
# Any scope (phase 3). Sum of the members' grant weights as the Yuan pays them (equal to oe_yw_wsum while no appanage is lost).
oe_yw_wpay = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:QAS c:QAS = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } }
        if = { limit = { c:QAS = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 1 } } add = 3 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:QAS = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:QAS = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 } } add = 0 }
        else = { add = 2 }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HCN c:HCN = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } }
        if = { limit = { c:HCN = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 1 } } add = 3 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:HCN = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:HCN = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 } } add = 0 }
        else = { add = 2 }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:OTC c:OTC = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } }
        if = { limit = { c:OTC = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 1 } } add = 3 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:OTC = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:OTC = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 } } add = 0 }
        else = { add = 2 }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BGT c:BGT = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } }
        if = { limit = { c:BGT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 1 } } add = 3 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:BGT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:BGT = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 } } add = 0 }
        else = { add = 2 }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:OGE c:OGE = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } }
        if = { limit = { c:OGE = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 1 } } add = 1.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:OGE = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 2 } } add = 0.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:OGE = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 } } add = 0 }
        else = { add = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LNG c:LNG = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } }
        if = { limit = { c:LNG = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 1 } } add = 1.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:LNG = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 2 } } add = 0.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:LNG = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 } } add = 0 }
        else = { add = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YLU c:YLU = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } }
        if = { limit = { c:YLU = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 1 } } add = 1.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:YLU = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 2 } } add = 0.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:YLU = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 } } add = 0 }
        else = { add = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YZW c:YZW = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } }
        if = { limit = { c:YZW = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 1 } } add = 1.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:YZW = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 2 } } add = 0.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:YZW = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 } } add = 0 }
        else = { add = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YBN c:YBN = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } add = 1 }
}
# Any scope. This year's grant total: unit x weights as paid x (2 in a year of a generous grant).
oe_yw_grant_total_value = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_grant_unit }
        value = global_var:oe_yw_grant_unit
        multiply = oe_yw_wpay
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yw_grant_mult ?= 2 } multiply = 2 }
    }
}
# CHI scope. Gold the Yuan must hold to pay: the total (twice the total for an AI Yuan).

    value = global_var:oe_yw_grant_total
    if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } multiply = 2 }
}

}
# Prince scope. Share of a sum (global var oe_yw_pot) split by grant weight among the members (event .2 b).
oe_yw_pot_share = {
    value = global_var:oe_yw_pot
    multiply = var:oe_yw_w
    divide = global_var:oe_yw_wsum_now
}
# Prince scope. Loyalty target 0-100 (design 3.3).
oe_yw_loy_target_value = {
    value = 55
    # the grant: paid this year (January) +10 (+15 in a generous year), lapsed this year -10; Shen gets none
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_paid_y var:oe_yw_paid_y = oe_yw_year }
        add = 10
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_variable = oe_yw_boost_y var:oe_yw_boost_y = oe_yw_year } } add = 5 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_lapse_y var:oe_yw_lapse_y = oe_yw_year } add = -10 }
    # came to the assembly within the last 12 months (it meets in June)
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_yw_att_y
            OR = {
                var:oe_yw_att_y = oe_yw_year
                AND = { var:oe_yw_att_y = oe_yw_year_prev current_month < 6 }
            }
        }
        add = 5
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_yw_bayan_in_power = yes } add = -10 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_grief } subtract = global_var:oe_yw_grief }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_restore_until global_var:oe_yw_restore_until >= global_var:oe_yw_m } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { situation:red_turban_rebellions = { situation_is_active = yes } } add = -10 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_ev has_variable = oe_yw_ev_until var:oe_yw_ev_until >= global_var:oe_yw_m } add = var:oe_yw_ev }
    # phase 3 (M2): the appanage lost and the grant halved -5, stopped -10 (a far prince -15), as long as it stays lost
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_fy ?= 2 } add = -5 }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 oe_yw_far = yes } add = -15 }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_fy ?= 3 } add = -10 }
    }
    # phase 3 (M10): the Liaoyang secretariat checks the eastern princes
    if = { limit = { oe_yw_east = yes } add = oe_yw_ly_term }
    min = 0
    max = 100
}
# Prince scope. Tier from loyalty: 3 loyal (>= 70), 2 normal, 1 aloof (< 40), 0 estranged (< 20).
oe_yw_tier_value = {
    value = 2
    if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_loy >= 70 } value = 3 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_loy < 20 } value = 0 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_loy < 40 } value = 1 }
}
# Prince scope. Chance to come to the Shangdu assembly: loyalty -10, far princes -20 more, 10-90%.
oe_yw_att_chance = {
    value = var:oe_yw_loy
    add = -10
    if = { limit = { oe_yw_far = yes } add = -20 }
    min = 10
    max = 90
}

# Any scope. .2: 1-3 months after this line first saw Y4's .6 sent (oe_yw_d_yv6); without Y4, or once Y4 dropped .6,
# months 30-36 (1339.10-1340.4).
oe_yw_lo_2 = {
    value = 9999
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_d_yv6 } value = global_var:oe_yw_d_yv6 add = 1 }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { var:oe_yv_st_6 ?= 2 } } NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_variable = oe_yv_init } } } AND = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_variable = oe_yv_init NOT = { has_variable = oe_yv_on } NOT = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_6 } } } } } value = 30 }
}
oe_yw_hi_2 = {
    value = 9999
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_d_yv6 } value = global_var:oe_yw_d_yv6 add = 3 }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { var:oe_yv_st_6 ?= 2 } } NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_variable = oe_yv_init } } } AND = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_variable = oe_yv_init NOT = { has_variable = oe_yv_on } NOT = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_6 } } } } } value = 36 }
}
# Any scope (phase 3, M10). The Liaoyang secretariat's item in the eastern princes' loyalty target: by YLY's tier (Y3's
# country var oe_yp_tier: 3 compliant 3, 1 slack -3, 0 estranged -5, 2 nothing) while YLY is the Yuan's subject;
# once YLY is gone, -5 when the city of Liaoyang is held by neither the Yuan nor a Yuan subject.
oe_yw_ly_term = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI country_exists = c:YLY c:YLY = { is_subject_of = c:CHI has_variable = oe_yp_tier } }
        if = { limit = { c:YLY = { var:oe_yp_tier = 3 } } value = 3 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:YLY = { var:oe_yp_tier = 1 } } value = -3 }
        else_if = { limit = { c:YLY = { var:oe_yp_tier = 0 } } value = -5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI NOT = { country_exists = c:YLY } location:liaoyang = { NOT = { oe_yw_loc_ours = yes } } }
        value = -5
    }
}
# Any scope (test readout). YLY's tier, -1 when YLY is not the Yuan's subject (or the mod has no Y3).
oe_yw_ly_tier = {
    value = -1
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI country_exists = c:YLY c:YLY = { is_subject_of = c:CHI has_variable = oe_yp_tier } } value = c:YLY.var:oe_yp_tier }
}

# Any scope. W1 (the Shen faction's rising): from the month Y1 sent Goryeo's .3 (oe_y1_d_st3) for 3 months; without
# Y1 in this game, from the month Goryeo's king was no longer Chungsuk (oe_yw_d_kor). 9999 while waiting.
oe_yw_lo_w1 = {
    value = 9999
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_init has_global_variable = oe_y1_m }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_st_3 ?= 1 has_global_variable = oe_y1_d_st3 } value = global_var:oe_y1_d_st3 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_d_kor } value = global_var:oe_yw_d_kor }
}
oe_yw_hi_w1 = { value = oe_yw_lo_w1 add = 2 }
